location_change.arrival_point_base: Gerardmer town center (Blvd d'Alsace bus stop)
location_change.notes_base: No direct train to Gerardmer. Recommended route: TGV Paris Gare de l'Est 07:00 → Nancy ~08:37, TER Nancy → Epinal ~09:30, TER Epinal → Remiremont ~10:00 (30min), Bus Remiremont → Gerardmer ~10:30 (35min), arrive Gerardmer ~11:30-12:30. May 1 is Labour Day (Fête du Travail) — trains run on Sunday schedule, intercity buses may run reduced frequency. Book TGV in advance on SNCF Connect app (sncf-connect.com). Estimated cost: ~60-80 EUR per person (TGV ~45-55 EUR + TER ~8 EUR + bus ~3 EUR). Total journey ~5h. Nearest train station to Gerardmer is Remiremont (27km, bus connection). GPS Gare de l'Est: 48.8768°N, 2.3592°E. GPS Gérardmer: 48.0701°N, 6.8773°E.
location_change.notes_local: Pas de train direct pour Gérardmer. Itinéraire recommandé : TGV Paris Est 07h00 → Nancy ~08h37, TER Nancy → Épinal, TER Épinal → Remiremont (30min), Car ligne 66 Remiremont → Gérardmer (35min). Le 1er mai est férié — trains en service dimanche, cars en fréquence réduite. Réserver le TGV à l'avance sur SNCF Connect. Tarif estimé : 60-80€/personne. La gare la plus proche de Gérardmer est Remiremont (27km).

journey_segments.notes: TGV to Nancy (~1h37), change to TER to Epinal (~57min)
Bus departs from Remiremont bus station (100m from train station). Walk 7min from bus stop to accommodation.

route_1.notes_base: Grand Ballon is 62km from Gerardmer (1h20 drive). No public bus service to Grand Ballon trailhead. Taxi required — estimated 80-100 EUR one-way for 2 people (private hire). Alternative: book a guided taxi-tour. Local taxi companies in Gerardmer: Taxi Gérardmer (taxis at the lake/town center), contact via tourist office at +33 3 29 27 27 27. Trailhead parking GPS: 47.9116°N, 7.2093°E (D431G, near Vieil Armand/Hartmannswillerkopf). Note: Grand Ballon trailhead accessed via Guebwiller side — confirm starting point with taxi driver. Consider combining outbound taxi with return bus if any service exists to Thann/Cernay.
route_1.notes_local: Grand Ballon est à 62km de Gérardmer (1h20 en voiture). Pas de bus public jusqu'au trailhead. Taxi nécessaire — environ 80-100€ aller simple pour 2 personnes. Contacter l'office de tourisme de Gérardmer (+33 3 29 27 27 27) pour les taxis locaux. GPS parking: 47.9116°N, 7.2093°E.

route_1.name_base: Gerardmer to Sentier des Roches trailhead (Le Markstein)
route_1.to_base: Sentier des Roches parking, Le Markstein
route_1.to_local: Parking Sentier des Roches, Le Markstein
route_1.notes_base: Sentier des Roches is 34.6km from Gerardmer (49min drive). The parking/trailhead is at Le Markstein on D430. No public transport to this trailhead. Taxi estimated 50-65 EUR one-way. Important: Book taxi in advance for early morning departure (aim to start hike by 08:00-09:00). Sentier des Roches is the most technical/exposed route — requires hiking boots with ankle support. Hiking poles strongly recommended. The route connects Le Markstein to Wildenstein via rocky ridge — coordinate taxi pickup from Wildenstein end or do round-trip. GPS trailhead parking (Le Markstein): 47.9262°N, 7.0288°E. Hohneck & Cirques Glaciaires optional extension also accessible from this area (GPS Hohneck: 47.9047°N, 7.0024°E).
route_1.notes_local: Le parking du Sentier des Roches est au Markstein sur la D430. Pas de transport en commun. Taxi estimé 50-65€ aller simple. Réserver le taxi à l'avance pour départ matinal. Chaussures de randonnée obligatoires. GPS parking Le Markstein: 47.9262°N, 7.0288°E.

route_1.name_base: Gerardmer to Orbey / Trois Lacs trailhead (morning - taxi)
route_1.notes_base: Orbey is 45.9km from Gerardmer (48min drive). Tour des Trois Lacs starts near Orbey/Lac Blanc area. Taxi estimated 55-70 EUR one-way. Start hike early (07:30-08:00 departure) to allow completion by 13:00-14:00. GPS Lac Blanc (Orbey): 48.1356°N, 7.0895°E. GPS Orbey village: 48.1262°N, 7.1650°E.
route_1.notes_local: Orbey est à 45.9km de Gérardmer (48min en voiture). Le Tour des Trois Lacs part du secteur Orbey/Lac Blanc. Taxi estimé 55-70€. Départ matinal conseillé (7h30-8h). GPS Lac Blanc: 48.1356°N, 7.0895°E.

route_2.name_base: Orbey to Remiremont (afternoon - taxi, for return to Paris)
route_2.from_local: Orbey / fin du Tour des Trois Lacs
route_2.notes_base: After completing the Trois Lacs hike (~13:00-14:00), take taxi from Orbey to Remiremont station (72.7km, 1h15). Then board afternoon TER to Nancy, then TGV to Paris. Estimated taxi cost 90-110 EUR. Book taxi in advance for 13:30-14:00 pickup from Orbey. GPS Remiremont station: 48.0164°N, 6.5989°E.
route_2.notes_local: Après la randonnée Trois Lacs (~13h-14h), prendre un taxi d'Orbey à la gare de Remiremont (72.7km, 1h15). Puis TER vers Nancy et TGV vers Paris. Taxi estimé 90-110€. Réserver à l'avance pour pickup 13h30-14h00. GPS Gare Remiremont: 48.0164°N, 6.5989°E.

route_3.name_base: Remiremont to Paris Gare de l'Est (train - return)
route_3.name_local: Remiremont → Paris Gare de l'Est (train - retour)
route_3.notes_base: Return journey Remiremont → Nancy (TER, ~1h27) → Paris Gare de l'Est (TGV, ~1h37). Total ~3h36. Target afternoon departure from Remiremont around 15:00-16:00 (check SNCF timetables — trains approx every 2h). Estimated cost: 55-75 EUR per person (TER Remiremont-Nancy ~10 EUR + TGV Nancy-Paris ~45-65 EUR). Book TGV in advance on SNCF Connect. Last reasonable departure from Remiremont for Paris ~17:00 (arriving ~20:30). GPS Gare de l'Est Paris: 48.8768°N, 2.3592°E.
route_3.notes_local: Retour Remiremont → Nancy (TER, ~1h27) → Paris Gare de l'Est (TGV, ~1h37). Total ~3h36. Départ cible ~15h00-16h00 depuis Remiremont. Coût estimé: 55-75€/personne. Réserver le TGV sur SNCF Connect. Dernier départ raisonnable de Remiremont vers 17h00.

general_notes.no_train_to_gerardmer: There is NO train station in Gérardmer. The nearest station is Remiremont (27km away). All travel to/from Gérardmer requires bus (Car Ligne 66, operated by Fluo Grand Est) or taxi from Remiremont.
general_notes.may_1_labour_day_warning: May 1 is Fête du Travail (Labour Day) — a French public holiday. SNCF trains run on Sunday/holiday schedule. Intercity buses may run reduced frequency. Verify schedules on SNCF Connect and Fluo Grand Est website before booking. Some bus lines may not operate on May 1.
general_notes.local_taxis_gerardmer: Local taxi contacts in Gérardmer: Contact via Office de Tourisme Gérardmer: +33 3 29 27 27 27. Taxi availability is limited — BOOK IN ADVANCE especially for early morning trailhead runs. No Uber in this area.
general_notes.fluo_grand_est_bus: Fluo Grand Est operates the regional bus network including Remiremont-Gérardmer service. Website: fluo.eu. Bus Line 66: Remiremont ↔ Gérardmer, journey ~35-40 min, fare ~3-5 EUR. Check schedule for May 1 holiday service.
general_notes.sncf_booking: Book TGV tickets on SNCF Connect: sncf-connect.com. Booking 2-6 weeks in advance recommended for best prices. Ouigo (budget) trains also available Paris-Nancy at lower cost.
general_notes.no_rental_car: No rental car planned. All local transportation relies on pre-booked taxis. Budget ~250-300 EUR total for all taxi rides across 3 days for 2 people.
